planned harness entry points and refusal boundaries

planned_harness.worker_rule: every Chroma action uses fresh subprocess workers only

preconditions: fresh copy of verified LC4 baseline
new valid LC6 disposable marker with inventory-row-v1 and checksum b189…
production refusal probe pass before Chroma open
cases.command_or_harness_entry_point: future lc6_failure_injection.py -> orphan_repair_executor.py apply --inject failure_before_first_mutation
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: no mutation starts; clone remains baseline-equivalent
cases.expected_filesystem_state: clone inventory unchanged; no unsafe deletion; WAL/SHM absent
cases.expected_chroma_state: no logical mutation; baseline chunk/orphan state preserved
cases.expected_recovery_rollback_action: no rollback required; only verify no mutation occurred
cases.expected_residual_state_report: case report + apply_failure evidence + inventory proof
cases.cleanup_procedure: delete validated disposable clone/work only after evidence capture

cases.command_or_harness_entry_point: future lc6_failure_injection.py -> orphan_repair_executor.py apply --inject failure_halfway_through_deterministic
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: automatic complete rollback to baseline inventory
cases.expected_filesystem_state: post-failure clone equals baseline or explicit justified logical equivalence = exact inventory equality
cases.cleanup_procedure: delete validated clone/work after rollback proof
cases.post_cleanup_assertion: no lingering worker; no disposable data remains except preserved failed clone on unexpected result

cases.command_or_harness_entry_point: future lc6_failure_injection.py -> orphan_repair_executor.py apply --inject failure_during_alias_collapse

cases.expected_chroma_state: restored baseline state with no orphan regression
cases.expected_recovery_rollback_action: restore snapshot after all workers exit
cases.cleanup_procedure: delete validated disposable artifacts only after proof

cases.command_or_harness_entry_point: future lc6_failure_injection.py -> orphan_repair_executor.py apply --inject failure_before_retirement
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: automatic rollback; retired chunks remain restored baseline entries
cases.expected_chroma_state: RETIRE_CHUNKS present after rollback with row count 1 each
cases.expected_tracker_state: retirement digest present again in tracker after rollback
cases.cleanup_procedure: delete validated disposable artifacts
cases.post_cleanup_assertion: no failed disposable residue unless unexpected result preserved

second run must treat same clone as forbidden dirty target

cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: already-repaired clone is not reused as a clean baseline
cases.expected_filesystem_state: dirty clone preserved for case evidence; no cleanup until validated
cases.expected_chroma_state: no second mutation attempted on dirty clone
cases.expected_recovery_rollback_action: preserve dirty clone until case result verified, then delete only if authorized by plan outcome
cases.cleanup_procedure: delete case artifacts only after refusal proof and no diagnostic preservation needed

cases.injected_failure_point: worker timeout or malformed worker output
preconditions: timeout/malformed-output harness isolated to disposable scope
cases.command_or_harness_entry_point: future lc6_failure_injection.py worker-timeout/malformed-json harness around chroma_worker.py or executor subprocess
cases.expected_process_exit_result: controlled failure on timeout or malformed JSON
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: parent treats missing/malformed output as failure and stops
cases.expected_filesystem_state: no unsafe deletion; if mutation had not started clone remains unchanged, otherwise rollback required after worker exit
cases.expected_chroma_state: no lingering open-process state; no Component not running allowed in acceptance
cases.expected_tracker_state: unchanged or restored baseline after rollback
cases.expected_recovery_rollback_action: if mutation started, rollback only after worker exit; otherwise refusal-only proof
cases.cleanup_procedure: delete validated disposable artifacts after evidence capture
cases.post_cleanup_assertion: no lingering worker; no unsafe deletion

pre_case_checks: verify fresh clone copied from verified LC4 baseline
verify WAL/SHM clear unless case intentionally injects WAL/SHM
verify production refusal probe before mutation-capable case
capture production embedded.json/chroma.sqlite3 hashes read-only before case
post_case_checks: capture production embedded.json/chroma.sqlite3 hashes read-only after case
preserve unexpectedly failed clone for diagnosis and stop immediately
